title: Operator-norm L² bound for a covector field whose components satisfy the ball mean value identity
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, y ∈ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), ρ > 0, and let g : ℝⁿ → (ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝ) be continuous on closedBall(y, ρ). Here ‖·‖ is the operator norm and V := (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal. Suppose that for every e ∈ ℝⁿ the component z ↦ g(z)e satisfies the ball mean value identity ∫_{B̆_ρ(y)} g(z)e dz = V·g(y)e. Then ‖g(y)‖²·V ≤ ∫_{B̆_ρ(y)} ‖g(z)‖² dz.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → (Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (y : Euclid n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContinuousOn g (closedBall y ρ) → (∀ e : Euclid n, ∫ z in ball y ρ, g z e = (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal * g y e) → ‖g y‖ ^ 2 * (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in ball y ρ, ‖g z‖ ^ 2
